s.d: just, simply, indicating that something is generally known or cannot be changed, and is therefore to be accepted; often equivalent to a shrug
ex: Er ist eben ein Idiot...
He's an idiot, that's just how he is...

s.d: just, quickly, indicating that something is done fast or without much complication
ex: Ich geh mal eben zur Theke.
I'll just go to the bar.
Wo ist denn dein Mann? Der saß doch eben noch hier.
Where's your husband? He was sitting here just a minute ago.
Und du kannst mir sagen, wie gut (oder schlecht eben...) es ist.
And you can tell me how good (or even how bad...) it is.
Es sollte eben diese Entscheidung sein, die ihn in den Bankrott treiben würde.
It would be this very decision that drove him into bankruptcy.

s.d: exactly; used to express agreement with an argument while not having needed convincing

ex: Sie ist das Ebenbild ihrer Mutter
She's the spitting image of her mother

s.d: equal, evenly matched (of equal ability in a direct comparison or confrontation)
ex: Sie sind einander ebenbürtig.
They are evenly matched.
Sie fand keinen ebenbürtigen Ehemann.
She did not find a husband of equal birth.

s.d: floor, storey; used e.g. of car parks, not usually of houses

ex: auf psychischer Ebene
on a psychological level
den Weg ebnen
to pave the way
